biggest_catch: You need direct deposits totaling $5,000 or more per month for two consecutive months by February 1, 2027, the account must stay open until the bonus credits on or before March 1, 2027, and you must provide promo code 500DMD826 at account opening — plus you are ineligible if you owned a Commerce checking account or received a Commerce checking bonus in the last 12 months.
catches: Qualifying direct deposits must be recurring electronic deposits of paycheck, pension, or government benefits from your employer or the government; person-to-person payments (such as Zelle) are NOT considered direct deposits.
You must provide promo code 500DMD826 at the time of account opening; it cannot be added later.
Open the account between August 28, 2026 and October 27, 2026; direct deposits totaling $5,000+ per month must post for two (2) consecutive months by February 1, 2027.

To be eligible you must not have owned a Commerce Bank checking account or received a previous Commerce checking bonus in the last 12 months prior to account opening; cannot be combined with any other checking offers; only one offer per household.
The bonus is paid on or before March 1, 2027 only if all requirements are completed and your account remains open; the account must stay open through payout.
The $500 bonus will be reported as interest to the IRS — the bonus is taxable income.

Monthly service charge waived for first 60 days after new account opening for Commerce Interest and Commerce Relationship checking accounts; afterward $12/month (Interest, waived with one $500+ direct deposit or $1,000 daily balance) or $22/month (Relationship, waived with $5,000 average daily balance or $15,000 combined balances).
Offer may be revoked, restricted, or changed at any time at Commerce Bank's sole discretion.
